risk: OCFL-style immutability is valuable, but personal/sensitive material may need purge.
bounded_resolution: Never promise absolute immutable bytes; define explicit purge/tombstone policy.

risk: Unknown type should not block intake, but a known parser seeing unexpected structure must not guess.
bounded_resolution: Preserve/generic-process; fail specialized parse loudly.

risk: Broad claims are useful later; per-claim approval does not scale.
bounded_resolution: Supervised by default; batch review; review state explicit.

risk: Reconciliation can discover sameness later without breaking references.
bounded_resolution: Stable local IDs + explicit merge/split lineage; never rewrite history silently.

tension: Raw source label vs normalized identity
risk: Source names/types can be wrong or inconsistent, but are evidence of what source said.
bounded_resolution: Store both raw and normalized fields with basis.

risk: Property/value models are machine-friendly but can fragment civic statements beyond human verification.
bounded_resolution: Claim stays readable proposition; structured enrichments auxiliary.

risk: Simple updates/contradicts is an edge; role/time/percentage relationship has independent meaning.
bounded_resolution: Promotion rule to typed association/event when attributes matter.

risk: Relations are first-class, but workload is bounded and local.
bounded_resolution: SQLite explicit tables + recursive queries; graph DB only after measurement.

risk: Many standards solve adjacent problems but bring RDF/OWL/XML assumptions.
bounded_resolution: Map semantics at boundaries; do not require one runtime stack.

risk: Same civic document can have PDF/HTML/OCR; one PDF can contain several documents.
bounded_resolution: CivicDocument, Representation, Artifact remain separate.

risk: Offsets/page numbers can become stale after reprocessing.
bounded_resolution: Bind to representation identity/state and allow redundant selectors.

risk: Auditability matters, but canonicalizing every function call creates noise.
bounded_resolution: Persist consequential provenance; logs for ephemeral operations.

risk: Statement-level provenance is powerful for merged datasets.
bounded_resolution: Start claim-level; promote only if fixtures show mixed-source fields inside one claim.

risk: Cantons need different topics; interoperable labels/hierarchy may help later.
bounded_resolution: Local stable tags first; optional SKOS-like mapping/hierarchy later.

risk: Official source can contain errors; ActaKit must faithfully report source without becoming truth arbiter.
bounded_resolution: Store “source asserts X”; allow challenges/contradictions/corrections.

risk: Evidence may contain personal data not suitable for output.
bounded_resolution: Custody and publication representations/policies are separate.

risk: LLMs find claims/relations well but can hallucinate.
bounded_resolution: AI origin explicit; machine-only is valid but visibly distinct.

risk: Aliases make matching attractive; same-name people are dangerous.
bounded_resolution: Candidate scoring + strong identifiers + human review for ambiguity.

tension: Source capture completeness vs baseline simplicity
risk: WARC can preserve HTTP exchange precisely but most document imports do not need full web archive machinery.
bounded_resolution: Minimal Acquisition first; optional WARC capture adapter for dynamic/high-value sources.

risk: OCFL/BagIt solve storage/package concerns that differ from domain records.
bounded_resolution: Keep domain model independent; package at backup/export boundary.

risk: Search indices improve discovery but are derivative.
bounded_resolution: FTS rebuildable; vector search deferred until lexical+structured retrieval proves insufficient.

tension: Machine relation candidates vs graph contamination
risk: Automated relation extraction can create huge noisy networks.
bounded_resolution: Filter by origin/state; cap extraction; no inferred transitive edges.

tension: Batch review ergonomics vs ReviewBatch entity
risk: Bulk UX is needed; permanent batch identity often is not.
bounded_resolution: Atomic multi-record command writing individual review decisions.

risk: Profiles improve typed extraction but can make intake brittle.
bounded_resolution: Generic baseline always works; profile adds constraints and may fail independently.

risk: Audit roles matter semantically, but 8 job titles are fictional locally.
bounded_resolution: Record action/actor; minimal operator/read-only permissions.

risk: Shareable outputs are useful, arbitrary code with write access is dangerous.
bounded_resolution: Read-only output boundary first; package/plugin execution model later.

risk: Successful download/OCR/parser/schema does not prove semantic correctness.
bounded_resolution: Ground derived fixtures against source artifacts and expected identity/relations.
